name: Wilt-Leaf
description: The Shadowmoor elvish counterpart served by Gryffid; king and queen reside in Cayr Ulios.

description_citations.text: "Gryffid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Cayr Ulios the Wilt-Leaf royalty elevate Gryffid to First Vigilant; persuaded by Oona's demonstration, he agrees to protect Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: elevated him to the rank of First Vigilant.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds the king and queen suspended by Oona's vines and sacrifices himself to sunder the main link, immolating himself and the royal pair and depriving Oona of Cayr Ulios's magic.
timeline.quote: When he sundered the main vine, the surge of magical energy immolated him along with the king and queen.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A wurm tears up the Wilt-Leaf, turns Mistmeadow into a mudhole and makes the river jump its banks.
timeline.quote: Last time, it tore up the Wilt-Leaf, turned Mistmeadow into a mudhole, and made the river jump its banks.

citation.text: Duskdale Wurm (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A forest torn up by a wurm.

citation.text: Eventide: card flavor text (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
